page.overview:
Who is Two Punch Man?

Guardians of the Globe Global Defense Agency:

Two Punch Man is a minor character in the Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards.

He is a superhero with extreme super strength but only on his second punch.

He wears a red bodysuit, with a yellow cape, a white belt, and black gloves. On his head are two white circles.
